issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted 2026-08-12) decided to add a third dependency kind, `verifies`, and diagnose inverted verification gates structurally from that declaration, explicitly slating it as post-0.1 item R025. The project is now past 0.1 and no open bead covers it. Work: first verify whether any partial support already exists and record findings; extend the dependency schema/migrations for a `verifies` edge kind with checkpoint round-trip coverage and audit events on its mutations; add CLI surface to declare it (e.g. `bead dep add --kind verifies`); keep readiness gating keyed on `blocks` edges only; add the advisory inversion diagnosis (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) reported by doctor/lint — reported, never rejected at insert time, and never inferred from issue titles; settle §3.4 cycle-rejection semantics for the new kind; atomicity and concurrency tests per AGENTS.md. Optional integration with R023's `why` explanation as noted in the ADR rationale.

issue.description:
ADR-001 is Accepted but no open bead carries its implementation. Add a third dependency kind `verifies` that authors declare at edge creation, and diagnose an inverted verification gate as a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead. The diagnosis is advisory only: report it in doctor/list output, never reject the edge at insert time, and never infer the relationship from issue titles. Needs schema and checkpoint round-trip support for the new edge kind (unknown-field-safe serialization), unchanged cycle rejection on the two-kind blocks set, and concurrency tests for edge insertion.
